milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the task is to mine green stained glass, and the mined drop ends up in the player's inventory. The scene provides a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe in the player's main hand via /replaceitem, ensuring the glass block drops as an item when broken (without Silk Touch, glass shatters and drops nothing). We check that the player has at least 1 green_stained_glass in their inventory, confirming they successfully mined a block.

scene_description: A stone platform with a 3-wide by 3-tall wall of green stained glass placed 4 blocks ahead of the player spawn. The player is equipped with a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe in their main hand. The task is to walk forward and mine at least one green stained glass block, which will drop as an item thanks to Silk Touch.
task_text: Mine a green stained glass block from the glass wall ahead of you using the diamond pickaxe in your hand.
design_notes: Stone floor: 7x10 platform from ~-3,-1,-3 to ~3,-1,6 provides stable footing. Green stained glass wall: 3 wide (x=-1 to x=1) × 3 tall (y=0 to y=2) at z=4, approximately 4 blocks ahead of spawn. Player has Silk Touch diamond pickaxe in main hand via /replaceitem so glass drops as an item when mined. The glass is at eye level and directly in the player's forward line of sight. The task requires: walk ~4 blocks forward, then mine any one of the 9 glass blocks with the equipped pickaxe.
